business_problem: Unilever Foods needed to keep brands visible in AI-driven search, accelerate food innovation as trends move faster, and deliver tailored recommendations to foodservice operators using real operational context rather than generic web scraping.
solution_summary: Unilever Foods describes a multi-part in-house AI implementation across marketing, R&D and foodservice. For digital visibility, the business uses AI search visibility platforms to monitor how brands such as Hellmann’s perform across large language models, detect prompt-level gaps, and trigger content updates including listicle pages, keyword changes and AI-friendly recipe formatting. In R&D, AI-powered product development analyzes taste signals, product data and customer feedback, digitally testing thousands of recipe variations so teams can predict promising flavour and texture combinations before physical trials. For Unilever Food Solutions, the UFS digital experience serves hyper-personalized recommendations by combining a proprietary data foundation, industry and trend research, 35,000 chef-authored recipes, culinary and product resources, and the expertise of 250 chefs with operator-specific inputs such as website information, menus, customer reviews and public social content.

solution_components.name: AI search visibility platforms
solution_components.role: These tools measure how Unilever Foods brands perform across large language models, identify visibility gaps, and guide content changes to improve recommendation likelihood.

solution_components.name: AI-powered product development
solution_components.role: This capability explores recipe variations, analyzes taste and product signals, and predicts strong product directions before live testing.

solution_components.name: UFS digital experience
solution_components.role: This customer-facing experience uses proprietary culinary data and operator business details to deliver real-time, hyper-personalized recommendations.

data_flow: For search visibility, recipe-related prompts are assessed through AI visibility tools, which surface gaps that feed content updates on brand websites. For product development, taste, product and customer feedback data are analyzed digitally to rank recipe options before physical trials. In UFS, proprietary recipe and trend assets are combined with operator website data, menus, reviews and public social content to generate real-time recommendations for foodservice operators.
business_outcome: Unilever Foods improved brand visibility in AI-mediated discovery, reduced development time for new food products, and gave foodservice customers more tailored recommendations based on their own operating context.
metrics: increased overall visibility score that almost doubled the 10% benchmark
architecture_clues: The search optimization workflow monitored prompt-level visibility across LLMs and drove website content fixes such as listicle creation, keyword updates and AI-friendly formatting.
UFS is built on proprietary data, industry and trends research, a recipe library, culinary resources and chef expertise rather than internet scraping alone.
UFS augments its internal data foundation with real business details from operators, including websites, menus, reviews and social content, to provide real-time analysis.
The deployment spans a global foodservice footprint with 250 chefs across 75 markets.
